purpose: Validate replayable temporal state, consent epochs, expiry and a proposal-only PUPILA-to-LUCIDA projection.

activities.label: exercise durable clock expiry consent revocation replay and proposal-only projection

queries.expression: does stale evidence stop affecting a reconstructed view
does revoking a consent epoch make prior evidence ineligible
does replay reconstruct the same eligible state after restart
does the output remain a read-only proposal without host actions or raw payload

assumptions: Fixtures are synthetic and do not represent observations of a real person.
SQLite persistence and deterministic replay are local experiment mechanisms, not a production service guarantee.
LUCIDA receives only a bounded projection and performs no host action.
kill_tests: Expired evidence must not affect a current view.
Evidence from a revoked consent epoch must not be eligible.
Reconstruction after restart must agree with the independent temporal reference.
The projected result must contain no raw payload or executable host action.
unknowns: Concurrent multi-process writers have not been validated.
No live LUCIDA host, network transport, sensor or human study was tested.
Production persistence, authentication and deployment policy remain unimplemented.
